## 中文
- **按需采集系统音频**。没有活跃输出流约 2 秒后，流光频谱会停止采集。播放恢复时自动重新采集，减少空闲时 macOS 录音指示紫点亮着的时间。 - 播放器保持输出流时，即使无声，macOS 仍可能显示紫点。你也可以在菜单栏选择「暂停系统音频」。
支持 macOS 14.4 及以上，包含 Apple Silicon 和 Intel 版本。已安装的用户可在菜单栏选择「检查更新…」。首次安装请下载 PrismPulse-macOS.zip，解压后将 App 拖入「应用程序」。
## English
- **Capture system audio on demand.** PrismPulse stops capturing after about two seconds without an active output stream and resumes when playback returns. This reduces the time the macOS recording indicator stays on while idle. - A player that keeps its output stream open may keep the purple dot visible during silence. You can also pause system audio capture from the menu bar.
Requires macOS 14.4 or later and supports Apple silicon and Intel. Choose Check for Updates from the PrismPulse menu. For a new installation, download PrismPulse-macOS.zip, unzip it, and move the app to Applications.
